source_row.rationale: Self-scheduling models, which give staff meaningful input into their own schedules within defined parameters (ensuring adequate unit coverage and fairness), are generally associated with improved staff satisfaction and a sense of autonomy and control over their work-life balance, when implemented thoughtfully with clear guidelines.
source_row.source_detail: Workforce scheduling/engagement resources support staff participation and structured coverage requirements; accessed 2026-08-14.
